To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) lossless synthesis can be combined with cut-based technology mapping to yield a scalable mapper with reduced structural bias, and (b) the use of supergates can also reduce structural bias.

(1) cut-based mapping is a promising technology mapping approach, (2) lossless synthesis is an important step in technology independent synthesis, and (3) supergates are an important tool for mitigating structural bias in technology independent synthesis.

(i) lossless synthesis is a new approach for reducing structural bias that combines the different networks seen by the technology mapper into a single network, and (ii) supergates help reduce structural bias and fit naturally in the framework of lossless synthesis.
